backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor definition; backend canister scaffold with no logic implemented.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting implemented Vault generation improvements, affected files, components, test IDs, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of frontend source files describing UI components, pages, hooks, and utilities across the application.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS setup defining light/dark theme variables, color tokens, borders, and base element styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point that mounts the React app at #root and loads the Vite/React main module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component defining core data models, validation/sanitization, navigation between pages, and localStorage-based persistence with autosave.
frontend/src/components/ConfirmDestructi: Reusable confirmation dialog for destructive actions, driven by a global confirmation store and ShadCN alert dialog components.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Minimal footer displaying copyright text, a heart icon, and a caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Responsive navigation header with project context, view navigation, mobile menu, and save status indicator.
frontend/src/components/SaveStatusIndica: Small, non-intrusive status label that shows saving or saved state during autosave operations.
frontend/src/components/VaultViewModeTog: Toggle control for switching the Vault display between compact and grid view modes using icon buttons.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Provides a React hook that creates and caches a backend actor using React Query, switching between anonymous and authenticated actors based on Internet Identity. It invalidates and refetches dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useConfirmDestructive: Implements a global confirmation dialog store using Zustand and exposes a hook that returns a promise-based confirm function for destructive actions.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Defines a context provider and hook for managing Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, persisted identity loading, and detailed login status flags.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Empty placeholder file indicating that no backend queries are used and persistence is handled via localStorage.
frontend/src/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS setup defining theme variables, typography, motion system, accessibility adjustments, utility classes, and shared animations.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the app with React Query and Internet Identity providers and imports global styles.
frontend/src/pages/Builder.tsx: Complex page component for building and previewing NFT assets, handling trait selection, canvas rendering, file uploads, and token deletion within a project.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Dashboard page for managing projects, including creating, editing settings, opening, and deleting projects with confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/pages/Preview.tsx: Renders a canvas preview of a project by randomly selecting weighted traits, validating them against rules, and compositing layer images with blend modes and opacity. Includes shuffle logic with rule checking, pixel-art mode toggle, and toast feedback.
frontend/src/pages/RarityWorkshop.tsx: UI for editing and normalizing trait rarity weights per layer, including auto-initialization, locking, proportional adjustments, and equalization. Ensures weights are valid, sum to 100, and updates project state with feedback.
frontend/src/pages/Rules.tsx: Manages creation, editing, duplication, and deletion of rule definitions that enforce exclude/force relationships between traits. Provides modal-based UI with validation to prevent invalid or self-referential rules.
frontend/src/pages/Vault.tsx: Displays generated NFTs with sorting, filtering, rarity analysis, and multiple view modes, and supports batch download via a custom ZIP generator. Handles image caching, progress reporting, and long-running operations while keeping the UI responsive.
frontend/src/pages/Workshop.tsx: Editor for managing layers and traits, including adding, renaming, deleting, reordering, and adjusting properties like opacity and blend mode. Safely updates project rules when layers are removed and provides inline editing with validation.
frontend/src/utils/persistence.ts: Centralized localStorage persistence with a single canonical snapshot using last-write-wins semantics. Includes load, save, legacy cleanup, storage size estimation, and quota warning helpers.
frontend/src/utils/yieldToUI.ts: Utility that yields execution back to the browser event loop using requestAnimationFrame and setTimeout to keep the UI responsive during heavy tasks.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration enabling class-based dark mode and scanning HTML/React sources, with extensive theme extensions for radii, colors via CSS variables, typography, spacing, screens, and custom animations/keyframes.
project_state.json: Machine-readable snapshot of the project’s current state and features, describing Studio Art Engine as a React/Tailwind generative NFT tool and enumerating implemented capabilities, versions, and metadata for planning and tracking.
